reviewSamples.author: Angela Thornton
reviewSamples.text: I am continually impressed by the beautiful environment and the efficient and professional Effect Med Spa staff. I have received great service from Brianna during my facial visits. She performed several different procedures on me, starting with the Signature Facial and Dermaplane and now the Diamond Glow and Brow Wax. I always leave feeling renewed and refreshed.

reviewSamples.author: Nichole Thomas
reviewSamples.text: Both Briana and Bri are wonderful! Briana is my aesthetician and she is so lovely. She listens to my skin care concerns and modifies based on my feedback. She makes my facials very relaxing. Bri is always so accommodating and helpful when scheduling or checking in/out.

reviewSamples.author: Valerie Steele
reviewSamples.text: I freaking love this place! All of the employees are warm and welcoming and the atmosphere is beautiful. They have a well thought out set of procedures they follow which show they are truly professional and trustworthy. And their aesthetician is the GOAT -- Nichole is exceptionally: 1) skillful, 2) knowledgeable 3) ethical and she is gorgeous inside and out. For those reasons, I keep coming back!

reviewSamples.author: Whitney Murray
reviewSamples.text: Melissa and the entire team at Effect Medspa are truly amazing! From the moment you walk through the door, they make you feel welcomed, comfortable, and beautiful, even if you're just coming in for a consultation. The team works so well together and genuinely cares about helping you achieve your beauty goals. They take the time to listen, explain each service in detail, and answer all your questions without any pressure. Their focus is making sure you feel confident, informed, and comfortable every step of the way. I highly recommend stopping by for a consultation, you'll quickly see why so many people love them!

reviewSamples.author: lindsey browne
reviewSamples.text: First of all I was told filler would hurt and it didn't. It's weird but not painful. Additionally they talked to me the whole time and I was not paying attention to the procedure. I am always twitchy when I get Botox but not with them. I have never felt more comfortable in the hands of Dr Melissa. I will never go anywhere else after this. They make you feel so at ease. They are so professional and Dr Melissa would sit me up to make sure things looked good. Thank you all for such a wonderful experience!
